title: EaW/FoC LSP schema - object kind file
description: Shape of eaw/kinds.yaml. Mirrors YamlKindFile/YamlKindEntry. A kind is a predicate over a game object's effective content - behaviour tokens, boolean tags, list membership - never a list of element names, because the engine ignores the element an object is declared with.

note.description: One thing worth saying about this element, and what sort of thing it is. The kind decides the severity the editor shows and ranks the note against its siblings; it is not the note's order in this list.

kind.description: BuggedInEngine: accepted by the parser but does nothing, or the wrong thing - an error. Deprecated: worked once, something replaced it. Untested: believed correct, never verified against the shipped corpus. Remark: a caveat with nothing to act on. Since: the version this appeared in, carried in 'value'.

value.description: What the kind carries besides prose - the version, for Since.

notes.description: Everything worth saying about this element. Replaces the deprecated/untested/availableSince fields of schema 1.x.

kind.description: Kind name, usable as a referenceType. Must not collide with a types.yaml typeName.

behaviors.description: Behaviour tokens; any of them in the object's <Behavior> list marks the kind. Mode lists (SpaceBehavior, LandBehavior, GalacticBehavior) do not count.

flags.description: Boolean tags; any of them true on the object marks the kind.

memberOf.description: List tags of other objects; being listed in any of them marks the kind.
